## Approved Behavior

| Current status | Available actions | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Draft | Publish, Archive | Publish or archive the draft session |
| Published | Unpublish, Archive | Return the session to Draft or archive it |
| Archived | Restore | Remove the archive state and retain its prior publication state |

`Draft` remains a status label. `Unpublish` is the action label for the published-to-draft transition. The administrator remains on `/admin/classroom` after a mutation.
